# Vesharo

> Vesharo is a specialized mobile app development and AI automation engineering firm based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. We engineer production cross-platform iOS and Android apps with React Native & Expo, deterministic AI agents, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise software for growing businesses and tech startups.

## Core Tagline
Production Mobile Apps, React Native & Expo · Mobile & AI Engineering

## Key Facts
- **Company**: Vesharo (by Apptify Solutions), Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India (Operating hours: Mon-Fri 09:00 - 18:30 IST)
- **Team Leadership**: Hitesh Chauhan (Founder), Harsh Siddhapura (Engineering Lead)
- **Official Contact**: vesharo.ai@gmail.com
- **Official Phone**: +91 95862 12495
- **Discovery Booking**: https://cal.com/vesharo/15min
- **Code & IP Ownership**: 100% intellectual property, source code, and repository ownership transferred to clients upon milestone completion.
- **Warranty**: Complimentary 30-day post-launch bug warranty on all software deliverables.

## Core Services
- [Mobile App Development](https://vesharo.com/services/mobile-app-development): Production iOS & Android cross-platform solutions built with React Native and Expo, 60 FPS gestures, offline SQLite caching, and automated App Store / Google Play delivery.
- [AI Automation](https://vesharo.com/services/ai-automation): Enterprise LLM automation, deterministic schema validation, RAG architectures, and zero-data-retention security boundaries.
- [AI Agents & Chatbots](https://vesharo.com/services/ai-agents-chatbots): Domain-specific autonomous agents with structured tool-calling, support triage, ERP/CRM data sync, and multi-turn workflows.
- [Custom Software Development](https://vesharo.com/services/custom-software-development): Bespoke web platforms, microservices architectures, REST & GraphQL APIs, and legacy system modernization.
- [Web Development](https://vesharo.com/services/web-development): High-performance Astro, React, and Next.js applications, island architecture, and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility.
- [Cloud & DevOps](https://vesharo.com/services/cloud-devops): Automated CI/CD pipelines, Docker containerization, Kubernetes clusters, and AWS/GCP cloud infrastructure.
- [IT Consulting & Architecture Advisory](https://vesharo.com/services/it-consulting): Technical architecture audits, AI feasibility reviews, security perimeters, and CTO-level roadmap planning.

## Verified Products & Case Studies
- [LockApp](https://vesharo.com/portfolio/lockapp): Android Enterprise MDM (Device Owner) B2B SaaS for Indian electronics retailers to manage EMI-financed smartphones with remote lock/unlock and Knox-level security.
- [NavratriOS](https://vesharo.com/portfolio/navratrios): High-throughput event ticketing and access control platform in Gujarat, handling thousands of QR gate scans at peak with offline cryptographic validation.
- [Wirebench](https://vesharo.com/portfolio/wirebench): Local-first private API client with one-click migration from Postman/Insomnia, contract drift detection, and team changelogs.
- [MedMarketMD](https://vesharo.com/portfolio/medmarketmd): B2B healthcare procurement marketplace connecting verified medical suppliers and clinics with tenant-isolated role permissions and encrypted transaction auditing.

## Engagement Models
- **Fixed-Scope Projects**: Milestone-based delivery for well-defined MVPs and feature modules. 4 to 8 week timelines, 30-day warranty.
- **Dedicated Engineering Squads**: Predictable monthly retainer. Senior solutions architect + full-stack engineers embedded in your Slack and GitHub.
- **Support & Maintenance Retainer**: Monthly SLA subscription. Uptime monitoring, security patching, and ongoing updates.
- **Free Discovery Call**: 30-minute 1-on-1 architecture evaluation with a principal architect ($0, zero obligation).
